LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime.label: Personality Gel
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime.description: Produced by personality excretion from people who are untrained or only briefly trained. A cyan slime-like fluid containing personality data. Can be implanted into targets that have already undergone personality excretion.
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_PLUS.label: Basic Personality Gel
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_PLUS.description: Produced by personality excretion from sex slaves trained to a certain level. A deep-blue slime-like fluid containing personality data. Can be implanted into targets that have already undergone personality excretion.
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_ULTRA.label: Advanced Personality Gel
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_ULTRA.description: Produced by personality excretion from sex slaves trained to a certain level. A purple slime-like fluid containing personality data. Can be implanted into targets that have already undergone personality excretion.
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_PLUS_ULTRA.label: Perfect Personality Gel
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_PLUS_ULTRA.descript: Produced by personality excretion from sex slaves trained to a certain level. A pink slime-like fluid containing personality data. Can be implanted into targets that have already undergone personality excretion.
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_Edited.label: Personality Gel (Edited)
LanguageData.SSC_PersonalitySlime_Edited.description: An edited and sculpted personality gel in humanoid statue form. After a sex slave uses it (inserted anally), they gain the Sex Slave trait.
